modules.title: Course Overview & Learning Roadmap
modules.description: Your starting point. Understand how to navigate this course, what you will learn, and build your personal learning path.

lessons.title: Welcome & How to Use This Course
Visual Learning Path: Beginner → Pro → Senior
Level Expectations: L4, L5, and L6

modules.title: Introduction to System Design
modules.description: The official System Design School primer: 12 lessons covering what system design is, interview expectations, how to prepare, core challenges, scaling, consistency, the master template, main components, and the full interview walkthrough. Best read before Module 3.

modules.title: Foundations (Beginner Friendly)
modules.description: The mental models every engineer needs before touching a single architecture diagram.

lessons.title: HTTP, DNS & TCP/IP — What You Actually Need
Scalability: Vertical vs Horizontal (with Real Cost Numbers)
CAP Theorem — The Pizza Shop Example
ACID vs BASE — The Banking Example

modules.title: System Design Patterns
modules.description: Four cross-cutting patterns that appear in almost every real system: scaling reads and writes, async job processing, real-time transport, and large file handling. Study these after M2 and before M3 — they are the bridge between building blocks and full designs.

modules.title: Core Building Blocks
modules.description: The components you will reach for in every real-world design — understood deeply enough to use correctly.

lessons.title: Load Balancers (Round Robin, Least Connections, IP Hash)
Message Queues & Event Streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
Rate Limiting & Throttling (Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket)
Indexes: B-Tree & LSM Tree with Query Performance
Blob / Object Storage (S3, GCS) — When to Use

modules.title: 15 Complete End-to-End System Designs
modules.description: Full designs with capacity estimates, schemas, API contracts, diagrams, and interview cheat sheets.

lessons.title: Design 11: Rate Limiter as a Service
Design 12: Distributed File Storage (like Google Drive)
Design 14: Social Media Feed / Timeline (Fanout Strategies)

modules.title: Deep Dives (Working Professionals)
modules.description: Production-grade patterns, failure modes, and architectural decisions that separate senior engineers from the rest.

lessons.title: CI/CD Pipeline Design for Large Teams

modules.title: Interview Mastery Track
modules.description: A complete playbook for system design interviews — from junior level through staff engineer.

lessons.title: The 45-Minute Framework for Any System Design Question
How to Drive the Conversation by Seniority
30 Most Common Questions with Model Answers
Common Mistakes & How to Avoid Them
Cheat Sheet: Latency, Throughput & Cost Numbers

modules.title: Globalisation & Real-World Deployment
modules.description: How to design systems that work for every country, every regulation, every network condition.

lessons.title: GDPR, CCPA & PDPA Built into Design
Designing for Emerging Markets (Low Bandwidth, Offline-First)

modules.title: Bonus: Course Creator Playbook
modules.description: Optional bonus module for engineers who want to teach system design themselves. Covers platform strategy, pricing, launch, community, and marketing. Not required for learning system design — skip if you are here as a student.

lessons.title: Platform Strategy (Udemy vs Teachable vs Own Site)
Launch Strategy: Beta Cohort → Full Launch

modules.title: Design Solutions Library — 34 Problems (Easy → Hard)
modules.description: Complete solution walkthroughs for 34 real interview problems: problem statement, clarifying questions, key concepts, high-level design, and deep dives. Sourced and structured for interview practice.
